verdict.rationale: First-party material describes building multi-step AI agents in workflows using your own data, models and tools (n8n-gh-9), with agent reasoning traceable on the canvas (n8n-docs-2) and a dedicated 'What agents do' docs page (n8n-docs-18). Model choice is supported across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and open-source providers, with switching "without changing your architecture" (n8n-gh-3, n8n-intdir-1/3/4), plus Ollama and Groq credentials (n8n-intdir-25, n8n-intdir-30). Tool use is backed by the MCP Client node (n8n-docs-20). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent/LLM steps, and in-depth docs detail on configuring agent tools (most docs evidence is page titles only).
